settings.initialization: First selected reading initializes the initial law once; subsequent selected readings are likelihood updates
settings.process_noise_scope: Model angular-velocity transition assumption; not extra noise added to generated sensor data

comparison_evaluation: Equal-weight RMSE on the identical common saved timestamps; last/posterior row at duplicate times. No estimate interpolation.
reference: Read-only synthetic reference; never returned to estimator

config.process_noise_location: angular velocity at prediction interval endpoint, before current observation

nonlinear.process_scope: independent isotropic body-omega increment at each selected interval END; q unchanged instantaneously
nonlinear.posterior: Markov transition plus gyro Bayes update at each acquired time; all past information retained recursively
nonlinear.conditional_statistics: E[qqT|omega], E[R|omega] and full Cov(vecR|omega); all rotation/omega dependence retained in omega-conditioned functions
nonlinear.observation_update: analytic Gaussian component conditioning; mixture weights normalized by exact component evidence
nonlinear.numerical_approximation: deterministic Gaussian-importance Nystrom quadrature in current omega only
nonlinear.numerical_tail_scope: A finite convolution-mixture quadrature can under-resolve far tails after large or sign-reversing innovations; order refinement and independent linear-Kalman differences must be reported
nonlinear.retained_state: continuous Gaussian mixture in omega with conditional quaternion/rotation moments; not a Dirac omega-node law
